rail.ticket.have: I already have a ticket. E — another one ({0} rub.)
rail.announce.doors: Please stand clear: the doors are closing.
rail.announce.last: This train terminates here. Please leave the carriages.
rail.announce.title: Train announcement
item.rail_ticket.name: Train ticket
item.rail_ticket.desc: A little cardboard ticket for the sea railway, single journey. The conductor punches it on the train.
item.rail_ticket_punched.name: Punched ticket
item.rail_ticket_punched.desc: A ticket with a hole from the punch: proof of a ride to the sea.
dev.action.rail.conductor: Train: the conductor comes to the hero now
rail.conductor.valya.name: Conductor Auntie Valya
rail.conductor.valya.ask: Tickets, my dears! Yours, young man?
rail.conductor.valya.punch: There, punched. Look out of the window: the gulls will come in a moment.
rail.conductor.valya.again: Already punched, I can see. Sit, sit.
rail.conductor.valya.warn: No ticket? Tut-tut. I'll let it go this once, but it's five roubles at the ticket office on the platform: don't forget.
rail.conductor.valya.fine: No ticket again. Well, dear, a fine of {0} roubles: here's the receipt.
rail.conductor.valya.broke: And no money either? Oh dear. Get off at the next halt and buy one, agreed?
rail.conductor.timofeich.name: Conductor Timofeich
rail.conductor.timofeich.warn: No ticket. Don't let me see you like this again.
rail.conductor.timofeich.fine: Riding without a ticket. Fine: {0} roubles. Rules are rules.
rail.conductor.timofeich.broke: Nothing to pay with? Off at the next halt.
rail.conductor.sato.name: Conductor Sato
rail.conductor.sato.punch: Thank you. Have a good ride to the sea.
rail.conductor.sato.again: Already checked. Sorry to bother you.
rail.conductor.sato.warn: No ticket...? Never mind. The ticket office is on the platform: next time, all right?
rail.conductor.sato.fine: I'm very sorry, but I must take a fine: {0} roubles.
rail.conductor.sato.broke: No money? Then please get off at the next halt and buy a ticket.
